prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE production city-map building sprite for tianshu, early-to-middle Qing Jiangnan region, 17th–18th century. The supplied Song Jiangnan image is a REFERENCE for the realistic material detail density and camera, NOT an edit target: generate an entirely new building of the stated type. Orthographic camera yaw45 elevation30; 2:1 dimetric ground projection, BOTH ground axes slopes precisely +0.5 and -0.5, verticals upright, parallel edges, NO perspective. Original South-facing entrance faces screen LOWER LEFT. True transparent RGBA background, all subject and short contact shadow completely inside canvas with at least 10% transparent margins. Very thin flat rectangular ground footprint with all three front ground corners clear; no thick diorama plinth. Realistic ancient architecture sprite, softly weathered off-white lime plaster, charcoal gray small fired clay roof tiles, gray brick/stone bases, dark timber and fine wood lattice windows. Modest Qing-style brick gate surrounds and restrained small carved trim; no ubiquitous imperial gilding, no giant ornamental roof curls. Light screen UPPER LEFT, small soft contact shadow screen LOWER RIGHT. NO sky, horizon, landscape, road outside footprint, humans, animals, calligraphy, labels, pseudo-writing, numbers, signage, watermark, checkers, plastic, cartoon, modern objects. This is an original generic game composite inspired by regional surviving Ming/Qing architectural forms, NOT a restoration of a named monument. Subject: ONE modest Qing Jiangnan gambling-house exterior, compact two-storey timber main house and small single-storey wing around one small courtyard, white plaster simple gabled end walls, gray tiles, dark fine lattice windows, bamboo blinds and one unlit open doorway. No text or gaming signs. CRITICAL GEOMETRY: the EAST-WEST frontage is10 metres and the NORTH-SOUTH DEPTH is8 metres; the mass must be nearly square in plan, NOT a long thin shophouse. Draw an exact rectangular thin ground pad as 2:1 isometric parallelogram with visible left corner L=(200,600), FRONT=(800,900), RIGHT=(1280,660), hidden rear=(680,360), or a uniformly rescaled and translated version. This means screen slope left-to-front+0.500 and front-to-right-0.500; horizontal edge lengths600:480=10:8. The house occupies the rear half with enough depth; main entrance on edge L-to-FRONT, toward LOWER LEFT. No trees and no plant clutter. Entire sprite and ground inside transparent margins.
